title: fix(objectql)!: refuse a currency path to no code field, and a record roll-up over an unfollowed amount, at a single-object save
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBUCxUdnFKS2gzgxGonxxHKW)_ Fixes #32312 Clause-②: yes (narrowing): after the cold boot, a published single-object save through `PUT /meta/object/:name` or the runtime `/meta` dispatcher, and a per-item publish (`POST /meta/object/:name/publish`), of a record-mode amount whose `currencyField` path `PARENT_FIELD.CODE_FIELD` names no ISO 4217 code field on the `master_detail` parent (or of a parent without the code field a registered child follows), of a `summary` declaring `currencyMode: 'record'` over a child amount that follows no record, or of an ADR-0144 D6 roll-up over a child amount in its own record currency, was answered `200` / `published` and is now refused `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 with nothing stored or promoted; nothing else moves for the follow pair. Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches no `PARENT_FIELD.CODE_FIELD` path and no `record` roll-up: its two `currencyMode: 'record'` hits at 898c2f46 are a sibling code field (`objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`) and a dataset measure (`objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`); the save-time rule is stated in `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` in this diff. > [!WARNING] > **BREAKING** — accept-set narrowing at three metadata doors, on a running server only: `PUT /meta/object/:name` (published), the runtime `/meta` dispatcher (published) and `POST /meta/object/:name/publish` now answer `422 INVALID_METADATA` and store or promote nothing for a currency path to no code field, a `record` roll-up over an amount that follows nothing, and (newly at these doors) D6's roll-up over an own-currency amount. The boot, `registerApp` (install, reload), draft saves, batch writers and a package publish do not move for the follow pair. ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**:服务器启动完成后，三个元数据入口(`PUT /meta/object/:name` 发布保存、运行时 `/meta` 分发器的发布保存、单项发布 `POST /meta/object/:name/publish`)会拒绝两类"货币对不上"的声明，回 422、不落库/不发布：子对象金额跟随 `父.币种字段`,但父对象上没有这个字段或它不是 ISO 4217 币种字段;以及声明 `currencyMode: 'record'` 的汇总字段，其子金额不跟随任何记录的币种。报错与 `defineStack` 一字不差(共用 `@objectstack/spec/data` 的同一模块)。D6 已有的同类拒绝在这三个入口也改为 422(以前是存下、回 200、只记日志)。 - **为什么改**:以前这类声明保存成功，作者要到录入数据时才在每一笔子金额上撞到 `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED`,或汇总被贴上并非其币种的父记录币种;单项发布更是回"已发布"却没注册。 - **风险与回滚**:跟随门只在调用方显式要求时才问(`againstRegistry`,且仅在冷启动封存后生效);`registerObject` 本身从不问，所以启动、水合、包安装与重载、草稿保存、批量写入、整包发布对这对声明的行为与 main 完全一致。回滚 = revert 本 PR。批量路径注册失败只记日志的老问题由 #32369 跟进。 - **先看**:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/registry-question.ts`(哪些入口会问，集中登记)、`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`(`objectRegistrationRefusal` 的 `againstRegistry` 与跟随门的唯一调用点)、`packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts`(`recordCurrencyFollowRefusal`,两端判定)、`packages/spec/src/data/record-currency-path.ts`(共享文案与谓词)。 - **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/record-currency-guards.test.ts -t 'follow door'`,预期 11 个用例全绿;真实启动:`packages/qa/dogfood/test/record-currency-follow-save-door.dogfood.test.ts` 8 个用例全绿。 - **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。 ## What changes **The door.** `recordCurrencyFollowRefusal` stands in `record-currency-aggregate-door.ts` beside the ADR-0144 D6 roll-up half (`recordCurrencySummaryRefusal`), with the same pair discipline: a pair is judged at whichever save completes it, and a pair with an end not registered yet is no verdict. - (a) A record-mode amount whose `currencyField` is `VIA.CODE` (segment 1 stays the spec object door's) and whose segment 2 names no field of the `master_detail` target, or a field that is not an `iso_4217_currency` code field, is refused. At the child's save with the parent registered, and at the parent's save (or re-save) with a following child registered; the message then leads with `'PARENT' does not hold the code a registered amount follows.` A code field the parent gets from a registered `objectExtensions` entry of an enabled package counts (a disabled package's is withheld at both ends, as the served fold withholds it). - (c) A `summary` declaring `currencyMode: 'record'` that rolls up `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` of a child field following no record (a `fixed` amount, a `dynamic` one, a plain number) is refused, at either end. A child amount in its own record currency, or following another record or through another relation, was already D6's refusal; that arm is pinned, not re-judged. - An `extend` body holds only the fields it adds, so only its own roll-ups are judged. A parent known only through extensions has no owner and `getObject` returns nothing for it, so it is no verdict, as `defineStack` skips it. - The answer is `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 (`RecordCurrencyFollowRefusedError`, `objectName` + `fieldName` naming the refused declaration), the D6 half's envelope. No new error code. **Opt-in (seat ruling on contract review 6782495106).** The follow door is asked only from `SchemaRegistry.objectRegistrationRefusal(…, { againstRegistry: true })`, and the option is honoured only once the cold boot has sealed the registry (`bareNameHoldersAreSealed`, set at `kernel:bootstrapped`). `registerObject` never asks it. Under the option the pre-flight also asks D6's door (it is otherwise body-only, #29673). The callers that pass it, enumerated in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/registry-question.ts`: - `saveMetaItem` in publish mode on face `meta-envelope` (`PUT /meta/:type/:name`) or `meta-dispatch` (the runtime `/meta` dispatcher) — `saveRegistryQuestion`; - the per-item publish `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish`, through `promoteDraftForPublish`, whose request now requires `registryQuestion` (`PROMOTION_REGISTRY_QUESTION`: `item-publish` asks against the registry, `package-publish` body-only), so a new producer must state its choice to compile. `REGISTRY_QUESTION_PRODUCERS` records every request-carrying `saveMetaItem` and `promoteDraftForPublish` call in a package's `src/**` (13 `saveMetaItem` and 2 `promoteDraftForPublish` calls), each with its question and why, exported from `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`; the census `packages/runtime/src/metadata-registry-question-producers.test.ts` fails when a call is added, removed or moved without a row. Why opt-in and post-seal, under AGENTS.md's startup-registry rule and #29673: a multi-registration unit registers in an order that can still complete a pair. The boot hydrates `sys_metadata` rows in no particular order, and every `registerApp` (cold boot, a post-seal install through the `manifest` service, a reload) registers a package's `objects` (`engine-registration.ts` step 2) before its `objectExtensions` (step 2b), so a child whose parent's code field comes from the package's own extension would be refused by a verdict the same unit then contradicts (F1). The batch writers write rows in their own order and only log a registration refusal. A single save or per-item publish has no sibling and answers its author, so it is the one place the question is both right and heard. This is a **ruled deviation** from the order's "at `registerObject`". **One builder.** The (a) messages, the (c) head and its unfollowed reason, and the code-field predicate moved from private helpers of `collectRecordCurrencyPathErrors` into `packages/spec/src/data/record-currency-path.ts` (`isRecordCurrencyCodeField`, `recordCurrencyFollowedCodeError`, `recordCurrencyRecordRollupError`, `recordCurrencyUnfollowedRollupError`), exported from `@objectstack/spec/data` beside the `controlled-by-parent-master` precedent. The stack check calls them; its findings and words are unchanged. No schema key moves; `api-surface` and `export-origins` regenerated (+4 functions, +2 interfaces). **FROM → TO** (sealed kernel): | door | FROM | TO | |---|---|---| | `PUT /meta/object/:name`, published (`meta-envelope`) | follow pair: `200`, stored, registered (refused at data entry); D6 pair: `200`, stored, `console.warn`, unregistered | `422 INVALID_METADATA`, nothing stored | | runtime `/meta` dispatcher, published (`meta-dispatch`) | same | `422 INVALID_METADATA`, nothing stored (same pre-flight line; read, not driven live) | | `POST /meta/object/:name/publish` (per-item) | follow pair: `published`, registered; D6 pair: `published`, `console.warn`, new object unregistered or old definition kept | `422 INVALID_METADATA`, nothing promoted; published row and registered object unchanged | | boot, hydration, `registerApp` (install, reload), draft save, batch writers, `publishPackageDrafts`, direct `registerObject` | — | unchanged for the follow pair; D6 unchanged | **Docs.** `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` states the save- and publish-time refusals, that a draft is judged at its publish, and that boot and package install are not judged this way. ## Tests `packages/objectql/src/record-currency-guards.test.ts`, top-level `describe` "the follow door", 11 cases. A `save()` helper models the metadata doors: `objectRegistrationRefusal(…, { againstRegistry: true })`, then `registerObject` only when it passes. 1. child path to a missing field → 422, message byte-equal to `defineStack`'s finding for the same pair; 2. child path to a non-code field → 422, byte-equal to `defineStack`; 3. parent saving after the child without the code field, and parent re-saving with it demoted to plain `text` → 422; the registered parent stays as it was; 4. `record` roll-up over a `fixed` and over a plain-number child amount → 422, both orders, byte-equal to `defineStack`; 5. `record` roll-up over a child amount in its own record currency → D6's `RecordCurrencySummaryRefusedError`, sealed and unsealed, at `registerObject` and at `save()`; 6. CONTROL: a correct path and the roll-up through that `master_detail` save in either order; a currency-less summary over a plain number saves; 7. CONTROL: a code field supplied by a registered extension counts, for the child's save and the owner's re-save; 8. F3: a disabled package's extension supplies no code field at either end (child save and parent re-save both refused); re-enabled, the parent saves; 9. `registerObject` never asks the follow door on a sealed registry (child to `invoice.title` and parent without its code both register), nor does the body-only pre-flight; 10. CONTROL (F1): a post-seal `registerApp` whose own `objectExtensions` supplies the parent's code field installs, the object and the extension's field registered; 11. cold boot: an unsealed registry admits even a `save()` naming the option. Beside D6's #29673 pin: the `againstRegistry` option changes nothing unsealed; sealed, the batch question returns `null` and the single-save question returns D6's refusal and registers nothing. `packages/runtime/src/metadata-registry-question-producers.test.ts` (3 cases, the runtime's `repo` tier, `heldBy` every `packages/**/*.ts` in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`): the producer census over every package's non-test `src/**/*.ts`, the by-face producers' faces and the two promotion producers' stated questions, `saveRegistryQuestion`'s truth table. It reads the table through the package's public export (as the other repo-tier census tests read `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/rest`), so the runtime's test type-check program keeps its `rootDir`. **Live, on a booted, sealed stack** (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/record-currency-follow-save-door.dogfood.test.ts`, 8 cases, `Tests 8 passed (8)`, tests 3.87 s): through `PUT /meta/object`, a child following `invoice.title` (no code) and `invoice.currency` (no field), a `record` roll-up over a `fixed` child amount, and D6's roll-up over an own-currency child amount each answer `422`, `code: INVALID_METADATA`, the door's message, then `GET` `404` and nothing registered; CONTROL: a child following `invoice.currency_code` saves `200` and registers. Through the per-item publish: a published, registered child following `invoice.currency_code` gets a draft repointed at `invoice.title` (saved `200`; the re-point is a destructive change, acknowledged with `force`), `POST …/publish` answers `422 INVALID_METADATA`, and the published row and the registered object still follow `invoice.currency_code`; a NEW object's bad draft saves `200`, its publish answers `422`, and nothing is published or registered.
RED on main (pins 1-4, first round) Main's `registry.ts` and `record-currency-aggregate-door.ts` put back with `git restore --source=origin/main` (tree only), the test file kept: `Tests 4 failed | 4 passed | 47 skipped (55)`, the four refusal cases `expected { code: undefined, … } to deeply equal { code: 'INVALID_METADATA', … }`. Restored; `git diff HEAD` empty.
Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to HEAD by blob, git diff HEAD empty) Head `fe6f55f7` for A5-A8: - A5, the opt-in dropped (`if (opts.againstRegistry === true && this.bareNameHoldersAreSealed) {` → `if (this.bareNameHoldersAreSealed) {`, `registry.ts`): pin 9 and the F1 CONTROL red, `Tests 2 failed | 9 passed | 48 skipped (59)`; blob `1e2970a4` → `5aafe6ff`, restored `1e2970a4`. - A6, F3 dropped (`… && !this.isPackageDisabled(c.packageId));` → `…);`): pin 8 red, `Tests 1 failed | 10 passed | 48 skipped (59)`; blob `1e2970a4` → `8cca4054`, restored. - A7, the per-item publish's question dropped (`againstRegistry: request.registryQuestion === 'against-registry',` → `againstRegistry: false,`, `protocol-history-and-publish.ts`), `metadata-protocol` rebuilt inside the ablation, live pin: both publish cases red, `expected 200 to be 422` with `"success":true … "Published draft — type=object, name=rcf_pub_line"`, `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)`; blob `acdcf89a` → `05f9d429`, restored; dist rebuilt after (`registryQuestion === "against-registry"` present once in `dist/index.js`). - A8, the save's question dropped (`{ againstRegistry: saveRegistryQuestion(…) === 'against-registry' },` → `{ againstRegistry: false },`, `protocol-save.ts`), dist rebuilt inside (hit 1 in `index.js` and `index.cjs`): the four `PUT` refusal cases red, `expected 200 to be 422` with `"Saved object 'rcf_bad_line' (env-wide, state=active)"`, `Tests 4 failed | 4 passed (8)`; blob `6b68dbac` → `2189ef51`, restored. First round (head `4ff7e7f7`, the door itself, still valid as the door's logic is unchanged): A1 the door dropped → pins 1-4 red; A3 the parent's extension fields dropped → pin 7 red.
## Acceptance notes 1. **Which doors hear the refusal, and which do not ask** (measured on a sealed dogfood stack where stated): | door | question | follow pair, bad | D6 pair | |---|---|---|---| | `PUT /meta/object/:name`, published (`meta-envelope`) | against registry | `422`, nothing stored (live) | `422`, nothing stored (live) | | runtime `/meta` dispatcher, published (`meta-dispatch`) | against registry | `422` (same line, read) | `422` (read) | | `POST /meta/object/:name/publish` | against registry | `422`, nothing promoted (live) | `422` (same line) | | draft save (`?mode=draft`) | body-only | `200`; judged at its publish (live) | same | | `publishPackageDrafts` | body-only | registers as on main (read) | refused at the write-through registration, `console.warn`, as on main (read) | | package duplicate, unmanaged import, external import, faceless internal callers (migration passes, CLI ownership) | body-only | registers as on main | `success: true`, stored, `console.warn`, unregistered (measured, as on main) | | `registerApp` (install, reload), boot, hydration | none | registers as on main (pin 10) | as on main | The batch and publish-batch relay of registry-dependent refusals is #32369 (the seat extends it with `publishPackageDrafts` and `registerApp`); the follow door joins those units once they relay. 2. **Boot census.** Boot paths that reach `registerObject`: artifact/manifest objects (`engine-registration.ts`, a throw stops the boot), manifest `objectExtensions` (after the package's objects), `sys_metadata` rows (`loadMetaFromDb`, per-row `catch` + `console.error`), overlay rows (same loop), hot reload (`ingestReloadedObjects`, caught). None asks the follow door, and the option is honoured only after the seal, so every boot registers what it registered on main. No shipped object uses a path `currencyField` or a summary `currencyConfig` (`git grep` over `examples/`, `packages/platform-objects`, `packages/plugins`, `packages/services`: 0 hits at 898c2f46). `os validate`: `examples/app-showcase` exit 0 (28 warnings, none currency), `examples/app-crm` exit 0 (4 warnings, none currency). 3. **A pair registered before the seal** with a bad follow is not judged until one end is saved or published again; then, as D6, a save of the parent is refused until the child or the parent's code field is fixed, including a save that changes something else. 4. **Not mirrored at runtime:** stack (b), an admitted roll-up through the followed `master_detail` that does not declare `currencyMode: 'record'` naming the parent's code field. Not in the card; it under-labels rather than mislabels. 5. A host whose kernel withholds the boot-phase hooks never seals, so there the option is never honoured (the bare-name doors share that posture). 6. Follow-ups filed by the seat: #32369 (batch, package publish and `registerApp` relay); one p3 card for N3 (`SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.writeFace`'s description, outside this diff) and N5 (the parent-end scan cost per single save). ## Verification All on head `3c3ae617` unless stated. - **dogfood_battery**: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `os-verify-lock` on `3c3ae617`: `Test Files 450 passed | 3 skipped (453)`, `Tests 3771 passed | 42 skipped (3813)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` (26m38s). The new live pin is inside it (8/8). - **Gates** (`dispatch-gates --ran`): `138 derived, 138 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, all exit 0. Basis, stated plainly: 52 re-run on `3c3ae617` (every family naming metadata-protocol, runtime, tests, vitest, type-check, exports, build, lint, generated, changeset, cross-package or alias, plus comment-mask, declaration-mirrors, issue-citations and ADR-0087), 24 on `12d73cb9` and 62 on `f14ec7c3`. The two later commits touch only the census test, its tier wiring and the metadata-protocol index export, which no carried family reads. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated` exit 0 on `3c3ae617` (`api-surface` / `export-origins` regenerated in this diff). - Suites: `@objectstack/objectql` `585 files / 12192 passed`; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `22663 passed | 29 skipped`; runtime census `3 passed` (`vitest --project repo`); `record-currency-guards.test.ts` `59 passed`. - Type check: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `tsc --noEmit` 0; `@objectstack/runtime` `check:test-typecheck` OK (27 files / 185 errors held by the ledger, unchanged). - `eslint` on every changed source file: 0. `os validate`: `examples/app-showcase` and `examples/app-crm` exit 0 (no currency warnings). - CI on `3c3ae617`: 58 success, 10 skipped (opt-in / label-gated lanes), 0 failed; mergeable, `clean`. CI fixes since the contract review's `24ae708d` (no change to the door or the opt-in): the census moved from metadata-protocol to the runtime's `repo` tier with `heldBy` (cross-package-test-inputs), the opt-in test gained the module-top `@objectstack/lint` import (test-source-alias), the census walk is paid once at collection (Test Core timeout, 6.4 s to 0.7 s), and the census reads the table through the `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` export instead of a source path (runtime test type-check, TS6059). --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01WGufzfg6ANtjV1U3Zvstgg)_ 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01WGufzfg6ANtjV1U3Zvstgg
